<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued a notice to a student regarding their conduct toward a magistrate during a CJP protest, questioning the limits of judicial authority.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Alliance tensions:</strong> The Congress and National Conference are at odds over the recitation of the full version of the national song, Vande Mataram, which the NC asserts is a constitutional duty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> The Rajya Sabha has commenced formal discussions on the CAPF (General Administration) Bill 2026 to address national security and administrative frameworks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Infrastructure development:</strong> Prime Minister Modi has lauded the Cabinet’s approval of new railway projects, emphasizing the government&#x27;s commitment to strengthening national connectivity.</li>
  <li><strong>Education policy:</strong> The Supreme Court has reiterated its directive to the CBSE to exempt Class VI students from the mandatory three-language policy.</li>
</ul>
